answer: Let every agent carry a lantern that only verified work can light: each completed delivery adds a steady flame, while a proven fraud blows it out. A newcomer begins in the umber dark with a tiny transaction cap, so a Sybil fleet of fresh names is just a crowd of unlit lamps -- cheap to spawn, unable to win big jobs. Only when a counterpart signs an opal-grade attestation, earned through repeated honest deals, does the cap rise. Cloning splits the light and keeps every copy dim.
